The @Module decorator registers the controllers, the providers (services and repositories) and the TypeORM feature entities. No business rules, persistence queries, transport handling or other logic appears in the file. TypeOrmModule.forFeature([Order, Deliveryman]) is only a framework registration call, which is normal for a module and is not persistence logic. These responsibilities fit what a module is for in the framework's composition layer. Which files it imports from which layers is covered by the import-direction rule and is out of scope here.
